Name: (CP)Decor Tent Kit
Author: gentlyfloating
Description:
This is a placeable, permanent tent for decoration purposes. You can find it in the decor section of the furniture catalogue. This tent is NOT functional like the original tent kit tent, but it will stay permanently. If you want to camp in the spot where you have the decorative one, you could remove it, place your tent kit, then replace the decorative tent in the morning. 

Requires Content Patcher
Other recolors of the original deployed tent kit will not affect this decorative tent.
